import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:felorx_api_client/felorx_api_client.dart';

void equalJson(Object? actual, Object? expected) {
  if (jsonEncode(actual) != jsonEncode(expected)) {
    throw StateError('Responses JSON round trip changed the wire payload');
  }
}

void main() {
  final inputs = <Object>[
    '你好',
    [
      {
        'role': 'user',
        'content': [
          {'type': 'input_text', 'text': '你好'},
        ],
      },
      {
        'type': 'function_call_output',
        'call_id': 'call_1',
        'output': '{"ok":true}',
      },
    ],
  ];
  final choices = <Object>[
    'auto',
    'none',
    'required',
    {'type': 'function', 'name': 'lookup'},
    {'type': 'custom', 'name': 'execute'},
  ];
  for (final input in inputs) {
    for (final choice in choices) {
      final request = FelorxResponsesCreateRequest(
        input: input,
        toolChoice: choice,
      );
      final json = jsonDecode(jsonEncode(request)) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      equalJson(json, {'input': input, 'tool_choice': choice});
      equalJson(FelorxResponsesCreateRequest.fromJson(json).toJson(), json);
      final count = FelorxResponsesCountRequest(
        input: input,
        toolChoice: choice,
      );
      equalJson(
        FelorxResponsesCountRequest.fromJson(count.toJson()).toJson(),
        json,
      );
    }
    final compact = FelorxResponsesCompactRequest(input: input);
    equalJson(
      FelorxResponsesCompactRequest.fromJson(compact.toJson()).toJson(),
      {'input': input},
    );
  }
}
